name: usage-meter
title: Usage meter
description: An allowance and what fills it: one bar split by source, the room left, a warning near the limit and the overflow in its own red well past a notch at the limit.
whenToUse: Plan limits and quotas: seats, storage, requests.
notFor: A single value on a range (gauge).

anatomy: header (label, figure with a status glyph when warn/over)
bar: allowance well (m-inset meter, sources in series colours up to the limit)
notch at the limit and overflow well (solid red), only when over
legend (swatch, label, value; room left or overflow with glyph and words)
states: over (red figure + ⓘ glyph, overflow well after the notch, 'N over' in the legend)
spec.motion: Segment widths ease over --pui-duration-standard when values change; nothing moves at rest. When the value changes, the change itself stays in view for a moment (_shared/delta-ghost): what was lost sits as a pale ghost under the fill, holds about 0.7 s and drains toward the new end; what was gained arrives lit and cools over about 1.3 s. The ghost spans the real before and after, never an in-between value; a run of changes the same way extends one ghost. Reduced motion: the ghost is shown still for 1.1 s, then removed.
spec.appearance: className/style address the existing visual root; native ref preserves internal measurements and focus. Typed classNames addresses documented existing parts; source owns deeper anatomy.

notes: §14.2 exception: `gap: 1px` between source segments is a hairline seam, not a spacing step.
§14.2 exception: the 'room left' legend swatch's 1px inset ring is a hairline boundary on --pui-line, not a look shadow.
